name: periodos-v3
hypothesis: In the final full games both arms spent 0-2 % of L4 quarter actions on Skill learning or rotation and stayed about 18-19 months at L4, although Skill is what L4 lacks. A climb Skill that identifies the blocker from the review talk, warnings and a failed review with Network and Output still rising (then Skill), and puts Skill learning plus rotation or mentorship there, will shorten the stay at L4 and raise the final level.
change: periodos-v2 with climb replaced by climb-v3 (blocker identification order: named by review or warning; failed review while N and O rise -> Skill; else least risen).
predicted_behaviour: At L4, Skill learning and rotation or mentorship become frequent quarter actions; 'blocker: Skill' in notes after a failed review at L4; shorter stay at L4 and more games reaching L5 and L6.
refutation: Refuted if Skill learning stays rare at L4, or if months at L4 and the level at month 42 do not improve against periodos-v1 over 20+ games cut at month 42.
